reload_data.required_new_behavior: Parse all inert JSON/CSV into a temporary catalog, preserve old catalog on error, resolve all sets/candidates, replace removed equipped items with Empty and report them, reset model overrides, rebuild models without loading a profile.

clipboard.required_new_behavior: Export the actual selected Quicklook/TP/WS set using typed base names and first CSV abbreviation, all 16 slots including Empty, title-case abbreviations, escape quotes/backslashes, preserve a Linux clipboard owner and report platform failures.

profile_error_and_unknown_key_handling.required_new_behavior: Unreadable/malformed JSON is visible and leaves current state and original file intact; preserve unknown profile keys on save; atomically replace JSON in the same directory. Preserve captured effective restore order and Python checkbox truthiness, not legacy pickle fallback.

inventory_cancel_and_read_error.required_new_behavior: Cancel/read error retains selections; completed empty/unrecognized imports clear them. Keep first CSV abbreviation matching and the actual bulk exclusions.

initial_state.normalization_source: actual tabs/simulate_tab.py:211-223; constructor-only debugger skip, paired with full compiled profile actions
